Welcome. This site holds the course materials for DATA 530: the weekly slides, handouts and readings. Assignments, submissions and grades stay in Canvas.

## How the course works

The course is fully online and asynchronous, with seven weeks and one textbook chapter each week. Every week follows the same rhythm:

1. **Read** the textbook chapter and one public health paper.
2. **Watch** the slides. The speaker notes explain each slide; press `S` in the slides to open them.
3. **Map** the ArcGIS Online exercises from the textbook.
4. **Keep** the weekly handout. It doubles as a cheat sheet for the labs.

## What you need

- **Textbook:** *Introduction to Human Geography Using ArcGIS Online* (Esri Press). The exercise links are on the book's resource page at [esri.com/Human-Geography](https://www.esri.com/Human-Geography).
- **ArcGIS Online:** use Emory's ArcGIS Online organization at [emory.maps.arcgis.com](https://emory.maps.arcgis.com). The [Emory GIS resources page](https://gis.ecds.emory.edu/) has the login instructions and free Esri training you can take with your NetID.
- **A web browser.** Nothing needs to be installed.

## Public health throughout

Each week ties GIS skills to real research from the Africa Health Research Institute's population surveillance site in rural KwaZulu-Natal, South Africa: the **ACDIS** health and demographic surveillance system and the **Vukuzazi** multimorbidity study.
